description: Blockchain Commons UR (Uniform Resources) test vectors: CRC-32, Bytewords, Xoshiro256**, random sampler, shuffle, degree and fragment choosers, fountain encoder, single and multipart UR strings. Every expected value is copied from the pinned sources below; none is computed here. Where a source only asserts behaviour at runtime, the entry says not_listed. Line citations are 1-based lines of the file at the pinned commit.

crc32.note: Only in the Swift test in BCR-2024-001, not in bc-ur test.cpp.

bytewords_invalid.input: able acid also lava zero jade need echo wolf

xoshiro.note: test.cpp lists next() % 100, not raw uint64 outputs. Raw uint64 values are not_listed in either source. Seeding: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes 'Wolf'; s[i] = big-endian uint64 from digest bytes [8i, 8i+8) (xoshiro256.cpp:43-53, 70-73).

checksum = CRC-32 of 'Wolf' as uint32 (0x598c84dc per test.cpp:28). Xoshiro256(uint32) serialises it as 4 big-endian bytes (utils.cpp:61-69), SHA-256s those 4 bytes, then maps the digest as above (xoshiro256.cpp:75-78).

make_message.algorithm: make_message(len, seed = "Wolf"): rng = Xoshiro256(seed) (SHA-256 of the seed's bytes, digest mapped big-endian into s[0..3]); return rng.next_data(len). next_data calls next_byte len times; next_byte = uint8(next_int(0, 255)) = uint8(uint64(next_double() * 256)), i.e. the top 8 bits of next() by way of a double, NOT the low byte of next(). Sources: test/test-utils.cpp:12-15, test/test-utils.hpp:16 (default seed "Wolf"), src/xoshiro256.cpp:80-100. The same helper is makeMessage in BCR-2024-001 lines 470-473.
make_message.make_message_ur: make_message_ur(len, seed = "Wolf"): message = make_message(len, seed); cbor = CBOR byte string (major type 2, definite length) wrapping message, via CborLite::encodeBytes; UR("bytes", cbor). Sources: test/test-utils.cpp:17-22, test/test-utils.hpp:17.

cases.note: test_xor calls Xoshiro256("Wolf").next_data(10), which is exactly make_message(10).
Second next_data(10) on the same rng: bytes 10..19 of the 'Wolf' stream.

make_message.not_listed: make_message(256), make_message(1024) and make_message(32767) are never printed whole. make_message(1024) is observable as the partition_and_join fragments (test.cpp:170-180) with the trailing zero padding removed, which test.cpp:183-184 asserts round-trips.

random_sampler.rng: Xoshiro256("Wolf"), next_double per draw, two draws per sample

shuffle.rng: one Xoshiro256("Wolf") reused for 10 successive full shuffles
a fresh Xoshiro256("Wolf") per row; row k stops after k items (Swift shuffled(count:))
shuffle.note: Every row is a prefix of test.cpp's first row, because a partial Fisher-Yates draws the same indexes as a full one up to that point.

choose_degree.seq_len_note: seq_len = number of fragments from partition_and_join (11, per the 11 fragments listed at test.cpp:170-180)
choose_degree.rng: for nonce in 1..200: fresh Xoshiro256("Wolf-" + decimal(nonce)), one choose_degree call each
one Xoshiro256("Wolf") shared across 1000 chooseDegree calls
choose_degree.note: Only in BCR-2024-001. Line 535 of the paper has a copy-paste typo ('let degrees = (1...1000).map' twice); the intent is unambiguous.

fountain_encoder.note: first_seq_num and min_fragment_len are the header defaults (fountain-encoder.hpp:50). The encoder increments before use, so the first part is seqNum 1 (fountain-encoder.cpp:115-120). description format is fountain-encoder.cpp:122-124; checksum is printed in decimal.
Encoder is_complete becomes true after exactly seq_len parts (fountain-encoder.hpp:61).
